cautions: AOD/dust and soil moisture are regional modeled context, not independent crop-stress labels.
The same atmospheric event is repeated across multiple fields on one date; do not count field-rows as independent dust events.
The field-date baseline comes from earlier accepted observations; the coverage_ratio_vs_p90 uses whole-season information and is for retrospective QA only.
Candidates were selected from NDVI drop <= -0.08 as an exploratory threshold, not a calibrated agronomic standard.
Separate Brazil Tanager hyperspectral observations are not joined to Egyptian field rows.
Source pixel radiometry and scene QA require original imagery for further independent validation.
